name: @papercusp/debounce-coalesce
description: Generic per-subscriber wake-floor + burst-coalesce primitive: a leading-edge debounce that enforces a minimum re-invocation interval per subscriber and folds the events suppressed inside the window into ONE delivery carrying their union, with an urgency bypass and a max-staleness deadline. Pure algorithm over injected time + state; zero domain coupling, zero runtime deps. The host persists the per-subscriber state and supplies `now`.
